summary: Frontend regression + new-feature verification for Andarak portal (theme toggle, Wisdom band, new hero photo). All 7 requested items PASS. 16/16 real checks pass on desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844. Portal fix from iter_2 (mobile menu createPortal) confirmed working — mobile-menu bbox height = 844 (full viewport).
verified_features: Theme toggle: [data-testid=theme-toggle] flips portal-root .dark class, computed bg goes from cream to rgb(19,26,37); icon Moon<->Sun; localStorage 'andarak-theme' persists across reload; toggle works both directions
Dark mode readability: /culture bento cards, /about blocks, headers all render with dark bg + light text (screenshots captured). No white-on-white or black-on-black.

Wisdom band: [data-testid=wisdom-band] present under hero. Eyebrow shows 'Мудрость поколений'/'Wisdom, passed down' (uppercase via CSS text-transform), wisdom-original + wisdom-translation testids present. Quote auto-rotates within 7s (verified: 'Ҳамсояи наздик...' → 'Хона аз ахлоқи...'). Language toggle updates translation line instantly without reload.
Hero image: loads OK (200, 1280x1267, 2.3MB), renders full-viewport autumn valley photo
Mobile 390px: [data-testid=mobile-theme-toggle] present in mobile menu, click toggles theme, localStorage persists
Regression /history: separate layout — no portal-root leaked, exit-to-portal link present, page renders
Regression mobile menu (iter_2 fix): bbox height = 844 (full viewport) — createPortal fix working
critical_code_review_comments: Wisdom.jsx: initial random idx is fine, but if a user keeps a tab open across route re-mounts they may see the same proverb again; interval clears/restarts on remount which is expected.
Minor console warning (framer-motion): 'container has a non-static position' — cosmetic, does not affect behavior.
Wisdom band bg is hardcoded '#16202E' (intentional per spec — always dark) which is consistent with footer's fixed navy — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 real checks; 3 initial 'failures' were false negatives from test-script substring/CSS-background assumptions)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Round-3 (theme + wisdom + new hero) fully verified. Wisdom quote rotates every 5.5s as designed. Portal-mount fix for mobile menu from iter_2 confirmed. If future work touches Wisdom, note that eyebrow uses CSS text-transform:uppercase so DOM textContent is title-case ('Мудрость поколений'), not upper — assertion scripts should compare case-insensitively or read innerText. Hero uses tag, not CSS background — future scripts should query 'img[src*=hero-valley]' not getComputedStyle.backgroundImage.
